Rashi on Pesachim 84b:11:1.hebrew: האי נמי כשר - שהרי הפנימי כשר, והרי הוא שוברו ועובר משום "לא תשברו בו". אלא חותך עד שמגיע לעצם, וקולף עד שמגיע לפרק וחותך, כדתנן במתניתין (לקמן פסחים דף פה:):
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:11:1.english: This one is also valid - For the inner [part of the limb] is valid, and he is breaking it and transgressing [the prohibition of] "you shall not break [a bone] in it." Rather, he cuts [the meat] until he reaches the bone, and peels [it back] until he reaches the joint and cuts [it off there], as we learned in the Mishnah (below, Pesachim 85b).

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:11:2.hebrew: האי לאו בר אכילה הוא - במקום שבירה אינו ראוי לאכילה. אבל אבר שיצא כולו, דהיינו היתה לו שעת הכושר ונפסל, דכ"ע אין בו משום שבירה, דהשתא מיהא פסול הוא: אליית השה קריבה עם האימורין, מה שאין כן בשור ועז, כדכתיב (ויקרא ג׳:ט׳) "חלבו האליה תמימה":
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:11:2.english: This is not fit for eating - At the site of the break, it is not fit for eating. However, [regarding] a limb that went out completely — which is [a case where] it had a moment of fitness and became disqualified — according to everyone it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking [a bone], since now, at any rate, it is disqualified. The fat-tail of a sheep is offered with the sacrificial parts [on the altar], which is not the case with an ox or a goat, as it is written (Leviticus 3:9): "its fat, the entire fat-tail."

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:13:1.hebrew: רבינא אמר - אי ליכא כזית בשר, דכולי עלמא אין בו משום שבירה; אלא באין בו כזית במקום שבירה ויש בו כזית במקום אחר, איכא בינייהו:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:13:1.english: Ravina said - If there is not an olive-bulk of meat [at all], according to everyone it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking [a bone]; rather, [a case] where there is not an olive-bulk on it at the place of the break, but there is an olive-bulk on it in another place, is the difference between them.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:14:1.hebrew: ואינו חייב על הפסול - והשתא מפרש ואזיל הי פסול קא ממעט. "היתה לו שעת הכושר ונפסל אין בו משום שבירת העצם" גרסינן, ו"רבי אומר" גרסינן ברישא, והיינו כרב יוסף. "למזבח" — למעוטי אליה, כדרב נחמן בר יצחק. "שלא בשעת אכילה" — מבעוד יום, כדאביי דאמר מבעוד יום. אתא רבי למעוטי שיעור אכילה במקום שבירה כרבינא, אי נמי למעוטי אין עליה כזית כרב אשי:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:14:1.english: And one is not liable for the disqualified [Paschal lamb] - Now [the baraita] proceeds to explain which disqualified [case] it excludes. We read [in the text]: "If it had a time of validity and became disqualified, it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone," and we read "Rabbi says" at the beginning, and this is in accordance with Rav Yosef. "To the altar" — [this comes] to exclude the fat tail, in accordance with Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak. "Not at the time of eating" — [meaning] while it is still day, in accordance with Abaye, who said [it refers to] while it is still day. Rabbi comes to exclude [a bone lacking] the measure of eating at the place of the break, in accordance with Ravina; alternatively, to exclude [a limb that] does not have an olive-bulk [of meat] upon it, in accordance with Rav Ashi.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:17:1.english: Is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone - For we require an edible measure at the place of breaking.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:1:1.hebrew: האי פסול הוא - שנעשה בפסול, דטומאה דחויה היא בציבור, אלא שכאן גזירת הכתוב לפוטרן בו:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:1:1.english: This one is disqualified - For it was performed in [a state of] disqualification, as [ritual] impurity is [merely] overridden for the community, except that here [it is] a Scriptural decree to exempt them with it.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:1:2.english: This [offering] is fit for eating - As we learned in a Mishnah (above, Pesachim 76b): The Paschal offering that is brought in [a state of] ritual impurity is eaten in [a state of] ritual impurity.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:20:1.hebrew: אמאי יש בו משום שבירת עצם - בין לר' יוחנן בין לריש לקיש, כזית בעינן:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:20:1.english: Why is it subject to [the prohibition against] breaking a bone - Both according to Rabbi Yochanan and according to Reish Lakish, we require an olive-bulk [of meat].

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:20:2.english: In this place - In the place of breaking.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:4:1.english: This [one] is valid - For its [sacrificial] services were performed validly.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:4:2.english: While it is still day - For it is not the time of eating.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:5:1.hebrew: נמנין על מוח שבראש - אפילו לא נמנה אלא על המוח, יצא:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:5:1.english: One may register for the marrow of the head - Even if one registered only for the marrow, he has fulfilled [his obligation].

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:5:2.hebrew: ואין נמנין על מוח הקולית - מפני שאסור לשוברה ולהוציאו, אבל מוח הראש יכול להוציא ולגוררו בקיסם דרך האף:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:5:2.english: And one may not register for the marrow of the thigh bone - Because it is forbidden to break it and remove it, but the marrow of the head one can remove and scrape it out with a splinter through the nose.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:6:1.hebrew: ניתי גומרתא - גחלת, וננחי עליה עד שינקב ויוציא מוחו:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:6:1.english: Let us bring a gumarta - A coal, and place [it] upon it until it is pierced and one removes its marrow.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:7:1.english: Rather, what have you to say - Why do they not register [for it] and extract [the marrow] with a coal?

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:7:2.hebrew: אביי אמר משום פקע - שמא מחמת הגחלת יפקע במקום אחר, ואין זו שריפה אלא שבירה:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:7:2.english: Abaye said: Because of bursting - Lest on account of the coal [the bone] burst in another place, and this is not burning, but rather breaking.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:7:3.hebrew: ורבא אמר משום הפסד קדשים - שמפסיד המוח ושורפו בידים, ומוטב שיפסל מאליו. הכא נמי, לענין שבירה מבעוד יום, אע"ג דמדאורייתא שרי, רבנן גזרו אטו משחשיכה:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:7:3.english: And Rava said: Because of ruining sacrificial food - For he ruins the marrow and burns it actively, and it is better that it become disqualified on its own. Here too, regarding breaking [a bone] while it is still day, even though by Torah law it is permitted, the Rabbis decreed [against it] due to [the concern lest one do so] after dark.

Rashi on Pesachim 84b:9:1.hebrew: אבר שיצא מקצתו - חוץ לחומת ירושלים, וצריך לחתוך את היוצא, איכא בינייהו:
Rashi on Pesachim 84b:9:1.english: A limb part of which went out - Outside the wall of Jerusalem, and one must cut off the [part that] went out, is [the difference] between them.

Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:15:1.hebrew: ה"ג היתה לו שעת הכושר ונפסל אין בו משום שבירת העצם - ול"ג "יש בו", דאי גר' תיקשי לרב יוסף, ולא משכחינן כארבעה מינייהו. ואית דגרס לעיל במילתיה דרב יוסף: למ"ד "כשר" — לאו כשר הוא, למ"ד "יאכל" — בר אכילה הוא; ולפי זה מיתוקמא גירסת הספרים דגר' "יש בו". ואין נראה, דבכולה שמעתין טפי נפיק מאכילה מדנפיק מתורת כשרות, כי ההיא דאבר שיצא מקצתו, דכשר קרי ליה ולא בר אכילה הוא:
Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:15:1.english: This is how we read [the text]: "If it had a time in which it was valid and it became disqualified, it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone" - And we do not read "it is subject to [breaking a bone]," for if we read [that], it would pose a difficulty for Rav Yosef, and we would not find [baraitot matching] four of them. There are those who read above in Rav Yosef's statement: "According to the one who says [the criterion is] 'valid,' it is not valid; according to the one who says [the criterion is] 'it shall be eaten,' it is fit for eating" — and according to this, the reading of the texts that read "it is subject to [breaking a bone]" is reconciled. However, [this] does not seem [correct], because throughout this entire sugya [an item] is excluded from "eating" more readily than it is excluded from the category of validity, like that [case] of a limb part of which went outside, which [the Gemara] calls "valid" yet it is not fit for eating.

Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:19:1.hebrew: איתמר אבר שאין עליו כזית בשר במקום זה כו' - נראה לר"י ולריב"א דאליבא דרבי קמיפלגי, דקתני בברייתא סתמא: "יש בו שיעור אכילה — יש בו משום שבירת העצם", ובפלוגתא דרבינא ורב אשי קמיפלגי; אבל לרבנן לכ"ע יש בו משום שבירת עצם. והא דמסיק: "אילימא דאין עליו כזית בשר כלל, אמאי יש בו משום שבירת עצם?", אע"ג דמצי לאוקומ' כרבנן — הואיל ואליבא דרבי קמיפלגי וסבירא להו כרבי, מוקמי למתני' כוותיה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:19:1.english: It was stated: A limb upon which there is not an olive-bulk of meat in this place, etc. - It appears to Ri and Riva that they disagree according to [the opinion of] Rabbi, as the baraita teaches anonymously: "[If] it has the measure of eating, it is subject to [the prohibition of] breaking the bone," and they disagree in the dispute of Ravina and Rav Ashi; however, according to the Rabbis, according to everyone it is subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone. And [as for] that which [the Gemara] continues: "If we say that there is not an olive-bulk of meat on it at all, why is it subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone?" — even though it could have established [the baraita] in accordance with the Rabbis, since they disagree according to [the opinion of] Rabbi and they hold like Rabbi, they establish the baraita in accordance with him.

Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:3:1.hebrew: היתה לו שעת הכושר ונפסל איכא בינייהו מאן דאמר כשר הא כשר הוא - לא משום דדריש "בו" — בכשר ולא בפסול — משמע ליה הכי, דהא ר' שמעון מפרש לעיל מילתיה דת"ק, דקתני נמי "בו" — בכשר ולא בפסול — וקאמר: אחד זה ואחד זה אין בו משום שבירת עצם; אלא דרב יוסף לא מצי למישכח מידי דאיכא בינייהו, אלא היתה לו שעת הכושר ונפסל:
Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:3:1.english: "[The practical difference between them is] a case where it had a time of validity and became disqualified; [according to] the one who says 'valid,' behold, it is valid" - [This is] not because [the Tanna] expounds "in it" — [meaning] in a valid [Paschal lamb] and not in a disqualified [one] — that this is implied to him; for behold, Rabbi Shimon explains above the statement of the Tanna Kamma — where it also teaches "in it," in a valid [one] and not in a disqualified [one] — and [yet] he says: [for] both this one and that one, it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone; rather, [it is] that Rav Yosef could not find anything that is [a practical difference] between them except [a case where] it had a time of validity and became disqualified.

Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:8:1.hebrew: אבר שיצא מקצתו איכא בינייהו מאן דאמר כשר כשר - תימה: אמאי חשיב ליה כשר טפי מבר אכילה? הא מה שאינו ראוי לאכילה לאו כשר הוא:
Tosafot on Pesachim 84b:8:1.english: A limb that partially went out is [the point of] difference between them; [according to] the one who says "valid," [it is] valid - [This is] astonishing: why does he consider it "valid" more than "fit for eating"? Behold, that which is not fit for eating is not valid!
